verses.1: And the great king Ziruzaydan made priests of falsehood and ministers of idols, against the Lord.
verses.2: And they offered sacrifices to them and poured out libations to them.
verses.3: And it seemed to them as though it were truly they who ate and drank.
verses.4: And they gave to those who slaughtered cattle and sheep and goats and calves; and they offered sacrifice in the morning and at evening, and ate of those unclean sacrifices.
verses.5: And it was not for themselves alone that they did this, but they compelled their people and made them serve their gods.
verses.6: And when they saw that the children of the captives were good and faithful, and that they worshipped the Lord their Creator, those deceitful gods wished to lead them astray, so that they would sacrifice and eat of those unclean sacrifices. And these blessed ones refused them.
verses.7: And they asked them, saying, 'Behold, your companions keep the commandment of their father, and strive in good works, and fear the Lord greatly.'
verses.8: And when they had spoken to them, they pressed upon them and urged them.
verses.9: And they told King Ziruzaydan that they had refused to bow down and sacrifice to his gods.
verses.10: And because of this the king was enraged and grieved, and he commanded that they be brought; and they brought them and set them before him, and he said to them, 'Sacrifice and bow down to my gods.'
verses.11: And they answered and said to him, 'We will not obey you in this matter, nor will we sacrifice to your unclean gods.'
verses.12: And he threatened them with many torments, but he could not move them, for their hearts were fixed upon the Lord.
verses.13: And he kindled a fire and cast them in, and they committed their souls to the Lord.
verses.14: And He showed them their living ones after death, while their swords were drawn, full of wrath, as he slept upon the bed of his kingdom in the night; and he feared greatly.
verses.15: And he said to them, 'What shall I do for you, my lords? Forgive me, and do not take my soul, and I will do all that you command me.' And he feared them greatly.
verses.16: And they told him all that they wished, saying, 'Remember that the Lord is your Creator, and that there is one who will bring you down from this pride of yours, and will cast you down into Gehenna below with Satan your father; and there you will finish all your existence, just as He burned us with fire, though there was nothing we had done wrong against you, while we worship the Lord our Creator and bow down to Him in His fear, to the Lord.'
verses.17: For He is the Creator of all, who made heaven and earth and the sea and all that is in them.
verses.18: The sun and the moon and the stars and every creature that the Lord created are His.
verses.19: And there is no other god besides Him, in heaven above or on earth below, who is able to do all things; and there is none who can deliver from Him, who kills and gives life, who is angry and who is gracious.
verses.20: And there is none who can deliver from His hand, for He is the King of heaven and earth.
verses.21: And there is none who transgresses His commandment, from what He created, except you and your companions and those like you, the companions whose heart Satan your father has blinded; and you and your gods will go down together into Gehenna, where there is no escape, forever.
verses.22: For it is not you who do this of your own accord, but Satan your teacher, who taught you this evil conduct, that you might oppress us.
verses.23: And you did not know the Lord your Creator, and you exalted yourself as though you were the Lord your Creator.
verses.24: And you are puffed up by the work of your hands and by your idols, until the Lord destroys you and brings you down to the depths of Gehenna, and you will be repaid for all the evil and the sin that you have done upon the earth.
